scripts.infra:reset: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker volume create infra_postgres_data
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && concurrently -n infra-postgres,infra-mosquitto,backend,frontend -c bgMagenta,bgYellow,bgGreen,bgBlue "npm run infra:logs:postgres" "npm run infra:logs:mosquitto" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
